title: cleisostoma demangei
intro: Cleisostoma demangei, commonly known as the Demange's orchid, is a species of orchid native to New Caledonia. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Cleisostoma demangei include potential uses in wound healing and as an antiseptic agent due to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids and phenolic acids. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of Cleisostoma demangei, but it is being studied for its potential in traditional medicine.
